name: vscode-translate-simon
displayName: VSCode Translate Simon - 翻译插件
description: VSCode Translate - 实时翻译插件，支持悬停翻译和选中翻译
author: Simon He <https://github.com/Simon-He95>

translate.local.autoStart.description: Auto start local translate server on VS Code startup

translate.local.url.description: Local translate server base URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5000). If set and reachable, extension will reuse it.

translate.local.command.description: Command to start the local translate server (run from extension folder).

translate.local.startupTimeoutMs.description: Max time to wait for local server to become ready

translate.local.requestTimeoutMs.description: HTTP request timeout when calling local server

translate.local.idleTimeoutMs.description: Idle timeout for local server; 0 disables auto-exit

translate.local.maxRestart.description: Max restart attempts for local server within a session

translate.local.offline.description: Offline mode: do not download models; require models to be present locally

translate.local.model.root.description: Optional model root directory. If set, server will try <root>/en-zh and <root>/zh-en

translate.local.model.enZh.description: Model name or local path for EN->ZH (e.g. Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-zh or /abs/path/to/model)

translate.local.model.zhEn.description: Model name or local path for ZH->EN (e.g. Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-zh-en or /abs/path/to/model)

translate.dark.description: Decoration style overrides for dark theme

translate.light.description: Decoration style overrides for light theme
